name: Bourd Rade
source:
The second-in-command of the Tenba conglomerate. Formerly just a strong warrior and an expert in researching ruins. He was hired for his skills, and becomes a member of Tenba's ruins search team. He thinks of Reyvateil as swappable weapons and does not treat them as people. This causes clashes between him and [url=/c3681]Lyner[/url], who respects Reyvateils as people.

He is an ambitious warrior who is the type to push over with sheer power rather than with skill. His armour is derived from both Tenba's technology and Lost Technology.

Voiced by: Richard Epcar (English)

[Edited from [url=http://nisamerica.com/games/artonelico/]Ar Tonelico Official Site[/url]]
